threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie when they still look confused by the Clapton Pond bus stop. Regulars glide through like they've got a secret.
Last night on the 196, a guy serenaded the whole bus with off-key Whitney. Somehow, it turned into a singalong. Only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I truly belonged when I saw a group of kids using a broken shopping cart as a makeshift go-kart in the park. Only here!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab shop with a techno DJ spinning vinyl at 4 AM, mixing authentic late-night snacks with beats for the true Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to check BART delays on Fridays before heading out. The train’s an oven by 5 PM, and the Civic Center’s like a no man’s land post-evacuation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy serenade passengers on the 19 Polk this morning—full on guitar. Everyone was annoyed until he hit the high note. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and plazas, but they miss how every street corner has a different sound—live music, chatter, and laughter blend into our daily life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they keep asking for directions to the nearest 'Mercat' instead of just looking up a 'supermercat'.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think waiting for a bus means you won't see ten cyclists zoom past. In Dalston, it's like a race you didn't sign up for.
Caught a couple arguing about which curry house was best, then the bus driver chimed in with his go-to spot. Only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when the kebab shop owner remembered my order. It’s the little things, like seeing the same stray cat sunbathing on my balcony every afternoon.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous parties in abandoned buildings with art installations, where the music complements the graffiti on the walls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows how to dodge the BART delays like it's an Olympic sport—gotta time those transfers to the bus just right.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus where a guy was trying to barter his homemade kombucha for a ride. Only in The Haight, I guess.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all Gràcia residents live in bohemian bliss. Most of us are just hustling to pay rent and navigate the noisy, never-ending fiestas.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they enthusiastically stand on the wrong side of the escalator, blocking locals rushing to get to work.
